highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.150.1 incorporates two upstream Skia m150 reliability fixes.
highlights_body: The servicing update corrects corrupt text-buffer cleanup and validates clipped render-pass bounds against the cleared stencil area.

bullets.lead: Corrupt Slug cleanup no longer risks invalid frees
bullets.detail: Skia now guarantees safe destruction order when deserializing a corrupt Slug buffer.

bullets.lead: Clipped render-pass stencil bounds are checked
bullets.detail: Rendering now checks clipped render-pass bounds against the stencil area that was cleared.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp advances from 14.2.1 to 14.2.1.1 alongside this SkiaSharp servicing release.
